SUN_S1E04_P01.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E04_P01.text: I'm beginning to feel very unsupported.

SUN_S1E04_P01.speaker: Ray
SUN_S1E04_P01.text: You always did mistake courtesy for surrender.

SUN_S1E04_P01.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E04_P01.text: Then that makes two things you've mistaken.

SUN_S1E04_P02.speaker: Ray
SUN_S1E04_P02.text: You were described with irritating accuracy.

SUN_S1E04_P02.speaker: Ray
SUN_S1E04_P02.text: He offered no surname. He did offer your friend's posture, coat, hair, and habit of looking at exits while other people are speaking.

SUN_S1E04_P02.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E04_P02.text: That last part is probably fair.

SUN_S1E04_P02.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E04_P02.text: When did he say Kael would arrive?

SUN_S1E04_P02.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E04_P02.text: What do you want from the Architect?

SUN_S1E04_P02.speaker: Ray
SUN_S1E04_P02.text: That he sold us out and left me to pay for it.

SUN_S1E04_P02.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E04_P02.text: Then I'm afraid you've waited for the wrong man.

SUN_S1E04_P02.speaker: Ray
SUN_S1E04_P02.text: That is exactly what he would say.

SUN_S1E04_P02.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E04_P02.text: I imagine that makes this difficult for both of us.

SUN_S1E04_P03.speaker: Samuel
SUN_S1E04_P03.text: Hold still. You're making the knot ugly.

SUN_S1E04_P03.speaker: Samuel
SUN_S1E04_P03.text: Ugly and painful are separate problems. I can fix one.

SUN_S1E04_P03.speaker: Samuel
SUN_S1E04_P03.text: Then one more minute won't improve my position much.

SUN_S1E04_P03.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E04_P03.text: He doesn't look like a con man.

SUN_S1E04_P03.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E04_P03.text: What does a con man look like?

SUN_S1E04_P04.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E04_P04.text: You told them he was Varnok.

SUN_S1E04_P04.speaker: Samuel
SUN_S1E04_P04.text: I told one angry man Varnok might come through. I described Kael.

SUN_S1E04_P04.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E04_P04.text: And you just…found whatever hurt most and put Kael in the middle of it.

SUN_S1E04_P04.speaker: Samuel
SUN_S1E04_P04.text: That's an ugly way to say it.

SUN_S1E04_P04.speaker: Samuel
SUN_S1E04_P04.text: Not mine. Veyra heard that story before I reached the Mirage.

SUN_S1E04_P04.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E04_P04.text: But you told Isabelle he'd come back.

SUN_S1E04_P04.speaker: Samuel
SUN_S1E04_P04.text: Veyra thought one of these names would make Kael know something he shouldn't.

SUN_S1E04_P04.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E04_P04.text: So you kept putting him in rooms where somebody wanted an answer badly enough to force one.

SUN_S1E04_P04.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E04_P04.text: And everybody else in the room?

SUN_S1E04_P04.speaker: Samuel
SUN_S1E04_P04.text: I told myself they'd be fine.

SUN_S1E04_P05.speaker: Veyra
SUN_S1E04_P05.text: I thought one of the names would make you slip.

SUN_S1E04_P05.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E04_P05.text: You asked who I used to be. I told you who I am.

SUN_S1E04_P05.speaker: Ray
SUN_S1E04_P05.text: You told me the Architect was coming.

SUN_S1E04_P05.speaker: Veyra
SUN_S1E04_P05.text: I told you I believed he might.

SUN_S1E04_P05.speaker: Ray
SUN_S1E04_P05.text: You told me what would keep me sitting at that table.

SUN_S1E04_P05.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E04_P05.text: You say that more easily now.

SUN_S1E04_P05.speaker: Veyra
SUN_S1E04_P05.text: Do not mistake accuracy for penitence.

SUN_S1E04_P05.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E04_P05.text: Did any of this tell you who I am?

SUN_S1E04_P06.speaker: Veyra
SUN_S1E04_P06.text: A trader out of the Mirage told me Isabelle had an old photograph and a man she had been waiting on for years.

SUN_S1E04_P06.speaker: Samuel
SUN_S1E04_P06.text: I went in after that. I told her he might come back before the next flare.

SUN_S1E04_P06.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E04_P06.text: Those were the four names you meant back at Cinder Basin.

SUN_S1E04_P06.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E04_P06.text: Please don't make this a thing.

SUN_S1E04_P06.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E04_P06.text: I knew I should have left both of you at the Last Drop.

SUN_S1E04_P06.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E04_P06.text: Do you still think none of this is about him?

SUN_S1E04_P06.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E04_P06.text: I think everybody keeps deciding what he means before they know him.
